part.text:
**Review — Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor (opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor, xhigh, plan)**

* Scope: `vendor-face-expressions-friendly.png` R4 atlas + 4x / 48px / 32px previews only, no workspace access
* Snapshot: `e85e7e67…01eb` — STATUS: **approved with nits**

Findings at 64px/4x and 48px:
* 5 expressions distinct: 1 diffuse amber no-pupil vs 4 defined iris+3x3 pupil+catchlight, 2 horizontal slit vs 5 45° down-right slit, 3 closed-arc pleased with centered smile all read clearly.
* Friendly: round cream-steel helmet, warm amber optic, small grille smiles, no harsh shapes. Stardew principle met — eyes+mouth carry personality.
* Pixel grid: clean nearest-neighbor, consistent 1px silhouette, no visible blur/AA/banding.

Nits at 32px stress:
* Neutral/surprise both collapse toward round amber dot — pupil survives as ~1-2px darkening but low margin.
* Talking/concern both thin slits — distinction relies on 0° vs 45° + centered vs off-center mouth, mouth dots near loss threshold.
* Pleased 1px end-ticks likely subpixel at 32px; concern cream high-end highlight risks aliasing.

No blockers; if 32px is real UI size, consider +1px pupil contrast and +1px tick/lip offset in next iteration. Cannot verify palette/alpha counts visually.
